get_in_memory_dataloader: get a DataLoader wrapping an InMemoryBinaryCriteoIterDataPipe or MultiHotCriteoIterDataPipe from binary numpy files on disk
review_get_dataloader: review the get_dataloader function to understand how it routes between random and in-memory data loaders based on args
